# Vladimir Milchakov

> Vladimir Milchakov, experimental physicist: Founder and CEO of Apex Qubits, Research Fellow in the QCD group at Aalto University.

## Key facts
- Founder and CEO, Apex Qubits (pre-incorporation), since November 2025
- Research Fellow, Quantum Computing and Devices (QCD) group, Aalto University, since June 2026
- Staff Engineer, Alice & Bob, August 2024 to January 2025
- Technical Project Leader, Qubit Coherence Project, IQM Quantum Computers, August 2022 to March 2024
- QPU Design Engineer, IQM Quantum Computers, October 2021 to March 2024
- PhD in Physics, CNRS Institut Néel, Université Grenoble Alpes, Grenoble, 2022
